story.text: 승객 여러분, 안녕하세요! 규현 기장입니다. 지금부터 조선 왕조의 심장, 경복궁으로 안내해 드리겠습니다.
story.reading: seung-gaek yeo-reo-bun, an-nyeong-ha-se-yo! gyu-hyeon gi-jang-im-ni-da. ji-geum-bu-teo jo-seon wang-jo-ui sim-jang, gyeong-bok-gung-eu-ro an-nae-hae deu-ri-get-seum-ni-da.
story.en: Hello passengers! This is Captain Kyuhyun. I'll now guide you to the heart of the Joseon Dynasty, Gyeongbokgung.

story.text: '경복궁'은 1395년에 지어진 조선의 정궁이에요. 오늘 첫 단어로 함께 배워볼까요?
story.en: 'Gyeongbokgung' is the main palace of Joseon, built in 1395. Shall we learn it as today's first word?

story.text: 궁의 정문은 '광화문'이라고 불러요. 이곳에서 오늘 우리의 탐방이 시작됩니다.
story.en: The palace's main gate is called 'Gwanghwamun'. Our exploration starts here.

story.text: 광화문 앞을 지키는 사람을 '수문장'이라고 해요. 매일 정해진 시간에 교대의식을 볼 수 있어요.
story.reading: gwang-hwa-mun ap-eul ji-ki-neun sa-ram-eul su-mun-jang-i-ra-go hae-yo.
story.en: The guard standing in front of Gwanghwamun is called 'Sumunjang'. You can watch the changing ceremony at set times each day.

story.text: 안으로 들어가면 국왕이 즉위식을 치른 '근정전'이 나와요. 조선 왕실의 가장 중요한 공간이었죠.
story.reading: an-eu-ro deu-reo-ga-myeon gu-gwang-i jeuk-wi-sik-eul chi-reun geun-jeong-jeon-i na-wa-yo.
story.en: Inside, you'll find 'Geunjeongjeon', where kings held their coronation ceremonies. It was the most important space of the Joseon royal family.

story.text: 참, '한복'을 입고 오시면 입장료가 무료랍니다! 전통 옷을 입고 궁을 걸어보는 것도 특별한 경험이에요.
story.reading: cham, han-bok-eul ib-go o-si-myeon ib-jang-nyo-ga mu-ryo-ram-ni-da!
story.en: By the way, admission is free if you wear 'hanbok'! Walking through the palace in traditional clothing is a special experience too.

story.text: 자, 오늘 배운 다섯 단어 기억나시나요? 이제 직접 문제를 풀면서 확인해볼 시간입니다!
story.reading: ja, o-neul bae-un da-seot dan-eo gi-eok-na-si-na-yo? i-je jik-jeop mun-je-reul pul-myeon-seo hwa-gin-hae-bol si-gan-im-ni-da!
story.en: Now, do you remember the five words we learned today? It's time to check by solving some questions yourself!

words.example: 궁궐은 옛 임금이 나랏일을 보던 곳입니다.
words.example_reading: gung-gwol-eun yet im-geum-i na-rat-il-eul bo-deon gos-im-ni-da
words.example_en: A royal palace is where a king of the past attended to state affairs.
Watch the Royal Guard Changing Ceremony.
The main hall is the most important building in a palace.

words.example: 정문을 지나야 궁궐 안으로 들어갈 수 있습니다.
words.example_reading: jeong-mun-eul ji-na-ya gung-gwol an-eu-ro deul-eo-gal su it-seum-ni-da
words.example_en: You must pass through the main gate to enter the palace.
Admission is free if you wear Hanbok.

sentences.en: Gyeongbokgung is the main palace of Joseon.
Guard Changing Ceremony is held daily.
Gwanghwamun Square is the heart of Seoul.

sentences.reading: jo-seon wang-jo yuk-baek-nyeon yeok-sa-ga dam-gyeo it-seum-ni-da
sentences.en: It holds 600 years of Joseon Dynasty history.
